pattern.description: The centred cube logomark shifts left to make room while the 'Notion' wordmark fades in beside it (mid-grey to solid black), resolving into the horizontal lockup.
pattern.why_premium: Two-step lockup: the mark owns the frame alone first, then yields space so the wordmark arrives without a cut; fast, quiet resolve on a flat warm background with the music tail decaying underneath.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.mark', {x: -offset, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.inOut'}).fromTo('.wordmark', {opacity: 0}, {opacity: 1, duration: 0.2, ease: 'power2.out'}, '-=0.1'); wordmark starts after the mark has begun moving.
build_hint.remotion: markX = interpolate(spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 120}}), [0, 1], [0, -offset]); wordmark opacity = interpolate(frame, [start+4, start+9], [0, 1], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}), delayed ~4 frames after the mark.

notes: Filmstrip panels appear framed on the logo (mark looks large); the end frame shows a small centred lockup. camera.move is none, so the scale/pan sums are read as the mark sliding and the wordmark appearing, not a camera move. b03 overlaps b02 (the same mark) and is not used.
